sn35.54:1.1: Kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato katham passato samyojanā pahiyyantīti || || Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahiyyanti || || Rūpe || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ || || Cakkhusamphassaṃ || || pe || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tampi aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahiyyanti || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evam passato saṃyojanā pahiyyantīti || ||
